title: Henstock--Kurzweil Path Integral in Financial Mathematics: A Machine-Verified Pricing of European and Barrier Options
abstract: arXiv:2608.19223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We apply the Henstock--Kurzweil (HK) gauge integral to the Black--Scholes model of option pricing and obtain the European call price directly from a Gaussian cylindrical kernel, without stochastic calculus. Under the risk- neutral measure, the log-price is a Brownian motion with drift nu = r - sigma^2/2. Its transition density is the Gaussian kernel G_t(x,y) = (2 pi sigma^2 t)^{-1/2} exp( - (y - x - nu t)^2 / (2 sigma^2 t) ). We give a machine-checked formalization in Lean 4 / Mathlib of the following: the Chapman--Kolmogorov (semigroup) property, the fact that G_t is a probability density, strong continuity of the pricing operator, the closed-form price C = S_0 N(d_1) - K e^{-rT} N(d_2) with the standard normal CDF N, and the exactness of the drift--diffusion Chernoff splitting at every level. The entire proof is "sorry"-free and depends only on propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. Digital and barrier options are treated as furthe

translated_title: 金融数学中的Henstock--Kurzweil路径积分：欧式与障碍期权的机器验证定价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19223v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们将Henstock--Kurzweil（HK）规范积分应用于布莱克-舒尔斯期权定价模型，并直接从高斯圆柱核获得欧式看涨期权价格，无需随机微积分。在风险中性测度下，对数价格是带漂移nu = r - sigma^2/2的布朗运动。其转移密度为高斯核G_t(x,y) = (2 pi sigma^2 t)^{-1/2} exp( - (y - x - nu t)^2 / (2 sigma^2 t) )。我们在Lean 4 / Mathlib中给出了以下内容的机器验证形式化：Chapman--Kolmogorov（半群）性质、G_t是概率密度的事实、定价算子的强连续性、闭式价格C = S_0 N(d_1) - K e^{-rT} N(d_2)（其中N为标准正态分布函数），以及漂移-扩散Chernoff分裂在每个级别的精确性。整个证明是“无sorry”的，且仅依赖于propext、Classical.choice和Quot.sound。数字期权和障碍期权作为进一步处理。
tldr: 本文用Henstock--Kurzweil积分在Lean 4中机器验证了欧式期权定价公式，无需随机微积分，并扩展至数字和障碍期权。
en_tdlr: This paper machine-verifies European option pricing using the Henstock--Kurzweil integral in Lean 4 without stochastic calculus, extending to digital and barrier options.
